āṇaṇyan.g: ettha Bhagavā pahīnakāmacchandanīvaraṇaṁ āṇaṇyasadisaṁ sesāni ārogyādisadisāni katvā dasseti.

āṇaṇyaṁ.g: ettha Bhagavā pahīnakāmacchandanīvaraṇaṁ āṇaṇyasadisaṁ sesāni ārogyādisadisāni katvā dasseti.
ettha Bhagavā pahīnakāmacchandanīvaraṇaṁ āṇaṇyasadisaṁ, sesāni ārogyādisadisāni katvā dasseti.

Āṇaṇyamuttaman.g: sabbesaṁ aṇaṇānaṁ khīṇāsavo uttama-aṇaṇo, tasmā arahattaphalaṁ āṇaṇyamuttamanti arahattaphalena desanāya kūṭaṁ gaṇhi.
